title: Great

author: Virginie_L

title: Perfect arrival experience
text:
Couldn't recommend this more highly, especially on your arrival day to Barcelona . Vincent spoke great English, but more importantly was able to capture the highlights of things I wanted to see versus my girlfriend. Very different interests but we got a combination of both!

What we both like most about it was getting " the lay of the land": hotspots, different neighborhoods, major attractions, hidden gems and getting a feeling for the old district (where we were staying) and the surrounding neighborhoods. 

Great value, and the private aspect cannot be overrated.
author: 2305mf

title: Perfect way to start your Barcelona trip
text: Perfect way to start your visit to this great city. Vincent started with finding out our interests and truly customizing for both of us. I strongly recommend anyone looking to get the lay of the land!
author: Michael_F

title: Memories made walking
text: Deborah was an absolutely fantastic guide in Barcelona! Super lovely, knowledgeable, and she really tailored the experience to our interests and pace. She made the whole tour feel personal, relaxed, and engaging. On top of that, she was incredibly funny and kind, which made the day even more enjoyable. We learned so much while having a great time. Highly recommend Deborah if you want a warm, insightful, and memorable tour experience!
author: Anna_S

title: Wonderful!
text:

Thank you very much for your flexibility and how pleased you were with me.

title: Amazing sights and fabulous guide
text:
Our walking tour covered almost "all" of Old Town Barcelona. We walked over 20,000 steps. Matilda was a fabulous guide, five stars plus. She contacted us before the tour so that we could make arrangements to go through the Sagrada Familia on our own, she is not a licensed guide for that church. We spent 8 hours with her and another 2 hours in the church on another day.
